title: Amazon ElastiCache: in-memory caching

kcs.statement: Amazon ElastiCache is a managed in-memory data store compatible with Redis OSS, Valkey and Memcached, giving sub-millisecond reads and offloading repeated queries from a database.
Typical ElastiCache uses are caching frequent database query results and storing user session data; adding a cache usually requires application code changes.
DAX caches only DynamoDB tables, so a cache in front of RDS, Aurora or another data source calls for ElastiCache rather than DAX.
